notes: Default ports 8000 (backend) and 5432 (postgres) conflict with the ontokit project when it's running. This config uses alternate ports. Vite proxy target is controlled by VITE_API_TARGET env var (vite.config.ts falls back to :8000 if unset).

servers.name: postgres (pgvector)
servers.command: docker start alea-intake-db || docker run -d --name alea-intake-db -e POSTGRES_DB=alea_intake -e POSTGRES_USER=alea -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=devpassword -p 5433:5432 pgvector/pgvector:pg17

servers.name: backend (FastAPI)
servers.command: PYTHONPATH=. ALEA_SECRET_KEY=$(openssl rand -hex 32) ALEA_DB_PORT=5433 ALEA_DB_PASSWORD=devpassword ALEA_MASTER_KEY_PATH=./data/master.key ALEA_CORS_ORIGINS='["http://localhost:8923"]' ALEA_FRONTEND_BASE_URL=http://localhost:8923 ALEA_OAUTH_REDIRECT_BASE_URL=http://localhost:8001 uv run uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8001
